capabilities: Display notes as Kanban cards filtered by tag or folder
Drag cards between columns to update frontmatter state
Create, complete, and delete tasks from the board or command palette
Visualize task timelines in a Gantt chart and a status dashboard
Configure multiple boards with custom columns, categories, and people
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README lists installation as pending community review and includes manual install steps. Supports English and Spanish.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visualize notes as a Kanban board or track their state through columns.
summary: Kanban board plugin that turns tagged markdown notes into draggable boards with custom columns, categories, completion tracking, Gantt charts, and a dashboard.
